verdict.rationale: Kimi documents automation-adjacent features such as scheduled tasks, skills, plugins and agent mode, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review history or rollback for user automations. The API's /v1 path versioning and model deprecation table cover API model IDs, not user automations, so they do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
